package.name: fixture-manual
package.title: Fixture Manual
package.description: One page carrying every block of the documentation genre, for the island golden.
package.abstract:
What it covers: one page that uses every block of the documentation genre once, so the island backend has a subject with no gaps.
For whom: whoever changes the renderer and needs to see what changed.
What it assumes known: nothing; it documents nothing real.
What it leaves out: prose worth reading.

pages.title: Addresses
pages.summary: A page address ends with a slash and the projections lie beside it as files: `…/<document>/`, `…/<document>.md`, `…/<document>.xml`.

pages.title: Every block once
pages.summary: This page uses every block of the documentation genre **once**, so the island backend has a subject with no gaps.
